items.html: And the matter is that at first, through the blessing "He who casts the bonds of sleep," etc., with the aforementioned intention, behold, that spirit (Ruach) of ZA that he gives into the Nukva in the first intercourse, to make her a vessel, returns and departs from her, in the secret of "and slumber upon the eyelids," and clings to its source within ZA. And then the Nukva does not shine at all through ZA, but only from the aspect of the upper Ima, of which it is said "and the Lord God built the rib," as mentioned, in the secret of "and He shines to the pupil of the daughter of the eye"; and she goes and is corrected, until finally "He brought her to the man," namely in "Sim Shalom" of the morning prayer. And it is found that now the female has returned to close her opening and her source as at first — a virgin whom no man has known.
